svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Property crime rates in the United States 1979 to 2024
Estimated property crime rate per 100,000 people. Property crime includes the offenses of burglary, larceny,
motor vehicle theft, and arson. Due to data availability, rates of arson are not shown.
Burglary (unlawful entry to commit a crime)

tspan.tspan: The FBI takes reported crime data and adjusts it for gaps and underreporting to provide consistent long-term estimates over time. That

text.tspan: means it may be different to reported crime figures.
